purpose: Test whether the non-bimodal task50 signal repeats across pre-registered unseen states before any selector-weight calibration.
rules: States are frozen before any state-expansion outcome is observed.
Every state first receives the same clean K=4 competence screen.
Only states with at least 3/4 clean successes receive the fixed K=8 stress test.
All eligible-state stress outcomes, including 0/8 and 8/8, remain in the report.
Discovery state 41 is excluded from this expansion.
No selector weight, threshold, intervention, state membership or candidate seed may change after launch.
This is development expansion, not independent confirmation or a main-experiment result.
